articles.title: New book highlights Alaska’s rural energy innovators
articles.summary: The Alaska Center for Energy and Power at the University of Alaska Fairbanks will host a free event celebrating the launch of “Alaska’s Microgrid Innovators,” a new book about the people and communities shaping Alaska’s energy future. Written by energy researchers, utility operators and rural community leaders, the book examines Alaska’s energy development through the […]

articles.title: AIDEA Buys $25M Equity Stake in Solid-State Nuclear Power Developer
articles.summary: The Alaska Industrial Development and Export Authority invested $25 million in Idaho-based NuCube Energy to develop compact, factory-built nuclear reactors.
